data.one_liner: Integrates Bugfender with Dart's standard logging package.
data.what_it_does: Bridges the logging package with Bugfender by listening to log records and forwarding them. It also allows adding and removing custom data for debugging sessions.
use_when: You are already using the standard Dart logging package in your Flutter app and want to send logs to Bugfender.
You need to attach custom metadata like usernames to your remote logs.
avoid_when: You do not use the Dart logging package.
You do not use Bugfender as your remote logging or crash reporting service.
strengths: Seamless integration between the standard logging package and Bugfender.
Supports custom data management for logs.
weaknesses: Tied specifically to Bugfender and the logging package.
data.setup_notes: Requires setting up a Bugfender app key and initializing the LoggingBugfenderListener.
